description: Avoid single-character variable names in production code because they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside a request loop when the data does not change
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries; use parameterized queries
Set explicit timeouts and bounded retries for outbound network calls
Do not log credentials tokens passwords or raw authorization headers
Prefer small cohesive functions with one responsibility over large multi-purpose functions
Add regression tests for bugs that previously reached production
Keep domain logic separate from transport and UI concerns
